speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're a child with frequent nosebleeds, bleeding gums or other mucous membranes, and small red spots on your skin (petechiae). Have you noticed any easy bruising or bleeding from cuts that won't stop?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP). The clinical presentation of mucous membrane bleeding, petechiae, and easy bruising in a child is highly suggestive of ITP. I have noted the history; please confirm if there have been any recent viral infections or trauma, as this supports the diagnosis without needing further invasive testing at this moment.
